nodes.label: -air-verify-program pass
nodes.description: Planned umbrella pass for static correctness checking: channel balance (P1), deadlock freedom (P2), resource bounds (P3), token constraint consistency (P4).

nodes.label: AIRAsyncDependencyGraph
nodes.description: Central data structure for correctness checker. Nodes are async operations; edges are Dependency, Affinity, Concurrency, Channel, StructuralBack, ParallelInit, ParallelReduce.

nodes.label: P1 - Channel Balance Check
nodes.description: Forward dataflow analysis ensuring every put is matched by a get on every execution path for each channel.

nodes.label: P2 - Deadlock Freedom Check
nodes.description: Uses Tarjan SCC on dependency and channel edge subgraphs (excluding structural back-edges) to detect deadlocks.

nodes.label: P3 - Resource Constraint Satisfaction
nodes.description: Bottom-up recursive analysis computing maximum concurrent resource footprint (tiles, L2 bytes, DMA channels) per scope and verifying against device capacity.

nodes.label: P4 - Token Constraint Consistency
nodes.description: Verifies affinity and concurrency constraints are mutually satisfiable; detects contradictions between sequential (affinity) and overlapping (concurrency) requirements.

nodes.label: ResourceFootprint
nodes.description: Struct tracking tiles, l2_bytes, and dma_channels for compile-time resource analysis of segments.

nodes.label: Rationale: P1 Before P2 in Correctness Checker
nodes.description: Channel balance (P1) verified before deadlock freedom (P2) because unbalanced channel is a special case of deadlock; confirming balance first simplifies deadlock analysis.
